long_biography.plain_text:
PhosAgro grew from the phosphate-mining assets Andrey Guryev began acquiring after managing Menatep Group's mining and chemicals division. He organised them around Apatit and built the resulting business into an integrated producer of phosphate rock and fertilisers, later floating the group in London while retaining family control.

Before entering industry, Guryev trained in physical education and worked in the Soviet sports system and Komsomol. Menatep gave him responsibility for industrial assets during Russia's post-Soviet privatisation. He also represented Murmansk region in the Federation Council from 2001 to 2013, combining industrial ownership with more than a decade in national public office.
